csd.why: the repository ships no CSD or IDCAMS DEFINE for EPSMORTF; EPSMLIST browses it by RBA (STARTBR ... RBA, which IBM allows only on an ESDS or a KSDS base) and reads it INTO MORTGAGE-COMPANY-INFO (COPY EPSMORTF), 56 bytes: an ESDS of fixed 56-byte records, the four companies in arrival order

scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: A100 lists from the COMMAREA it was never given (oracle_assumptions.md X12: LOW-VALUES here, so principal and rate are zero and no company passes A150's test); the whole ESDS browsed to ENDFILE

scenarios.name: list-rate-below-every-company
scenarios.why: A100: SEND MAP ERASE of LOW-VALUES; STARTBR RBA EQUAL at RBA 0 (the first record) NORMAL; READNEXT RBA reads the four records in arrival order (RIDFLD set to 0, 56, 112, 168), none with a rate below 3.500, so no line is filled and no LINK; the fifth READNEXT is ENDFILE; ENDBR; SEND MAP

scenarios.name: list-principal-above-every-loan
scenarios.why: the other half of A150's AND: every rate is below 9.000 but no loan exceeds 750000.00; the whole file is browsed to ENDFILE

scenarios.name: other-key
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER: the same list as ENTER

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: RETURN at once, the COMMAREA untouched

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: PF12: the same WHEN as PF3

scenarios.name: startbr-notfnd

faults.why: 13 on the STARTBR (an empty ESDS: no record at RBA 0)

scenarios.why: the STARTBR's ELSE: 'ERROR WITH START' in the first company line, the RESP (13) in the first loan field; no ENDBR (CLOSE-FILE 'N'); SEND MAP

scenarios.name: readnext-ioerr
scenarios.why: A150's inner ELSE: 'ERROR WITH READ NEXT' and the RESP (17) in the first line; END-OF-FILE stays 'N', so the loop reads on (the failed READNEXT left the browse where STARTBR put it) through the four records to ENDFILE

notes: IBM DBB MortgageApplication's company list (EPSMLIST, LINKed by EPSCMORT on PF9 and ENTER from the list): it browses the ESDS EPSMORTF by relative byte address (STARTBR RIDFLD(RID-LENGTH) RBA EQUAL with RBA 0, then READNEXT ... RBA) and lists, on map EPSMLIS (generated from epsmlis.bms, `@bms/`), each company whose loan exceeds the principal and whose rate is below the quoted rate. The repository ships no CSD or IDCAMS DEFINE for EPSMORTF and no data: the dataset is stated by the case (`csd`) and the four records are the case's own. Not reachable here: a company that passes A150's test LINKs EPSCSMRT for the payment, which compiles with CBL NUMPROC(MIG) -- refused (oracle_assumptions.md C5), so no scenario lists a company. EIBCALEN 0 (first-entry) MOVEs the unaddressed DFHCOMMAREA first, as EPSCMORT does (oracle_assumptions.md X12). No record's contents reach an output without that LINK, so the proof judges the browse by its outcomes (each READNEXT NORMAL until ENDFILE, the STARTBR and READNEXT error paths, ENDBR); the RBA rules themselves are pinned on both sides by tests/cics_crucible/test_cics_runtimes.py.
